goal: Schritt 1: CP-09 Entry-Field-Create-Slice vollständig gegen I47-I61 auditieren und fokussiert regressionsprüfen | Schritt 2: nur bei komplett grünem Zwischen-Gate formal einfrieren, andernfalls genau einen belegten Restvertrag schließen

guide_delta.topic: Feldanlage wird als stabiler Teilstand eingefroren
guide_delta.summary: Die bisherige Feldanlage wird noch einmal vollständig gegen ihre Sicherheitsregeln geprüft. Wenn alle gezielten Tests grün bleiben, wird genau dieser Funktionsblock eingefroren; neue Feldarten oder Feldwerte gehören ausdrücklich nicht dazu.

tests_required: Zwischen-Gate: all focused regressions green and no undeclared file changes
Schritt 2: if step 1 is green, update only I62 audit/manifest to frozen status and rerun targeted validation
tests_explicitly_not_run: full product suite because the audit targets only the established Entry-Field-Create slice
browser tests because CP-07H is outside this freeze
database/domain/repository suite because frozen core is unchanged
manual human perception acceptance because I61 explicitly separates it from automated evidence
risks: freezing too broad a CP-09 boundary would incorrectly close value, choice, money or category-field work; I62 freezes only the Entry-Field-Create slice
a future launcher/composition root is outside I47-I61 and must remain a separate scope
a failed focused regression must block freeze and permit only one directly evidenced contract fix
non_changes: no product code changes in step 1
no product patch in step 2 because the complete focused audit was green
CP-09 areas outside Entry-Field-Create remain unresolved rather than implicitly frozen
expected_side_effects: step 1 completed a full documented and regression-backed audit of I47-I61
step 2 formally freezes exactly the CP-09 Entry-Field-Create slice
future changes to adapter semantics, parent capture, allowed create types, write count, refresh or focus/error/cancel behavior require explicit REOPEN
